clean_description: Demon Copperhead follows a boy born to a teenage single mother in southern Appalachia, navigating the challenges of foster care, child labor, and addiction. Through his unsparing voice, he confronts the invisibility of rural people in modern culture while reflecting on the enduring issues of poverty and loss. This contemporary retelling of Dickens' David Copperfield explores the transformative power of storytelling amidst the struggles of a new generation.
